calls.head: Carolina should get plenty of shots away
calls.body: Carolina ranks 2nd of 32 for shot volume (66.7 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5); Vancouver ranks 30th for shot suppression.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 4 games this season
calls.happened: Carolina took 59.4 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5 (adjusted for score and venue), against its usual 66.7.

calls.head: Vancouver can’t afford to take penalties
calls.body: Vancouver’s penalty kill sits 28th of 32, and Carolina’s power play is 8th (8.0 expected goals per 60).
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 4 games this season
calls.happened: Carolina’s power play created 21.5 expected goals per 60 in 3:10 of 5-on-4 time, against its usual 8.0, and scored 3 goals.

surprises.head: Carolina controlled the chances
surprises.body: Expected goals ran 5.1 to 2.2 for Carolina, with empty nets left out.

surprises.head: Vancouver shot far less than usual
surprises.body: 30.1 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, adjusted for score and venue, against its usual 45.7.

surprises.head: Vancouver tried a different line
surprises.body: B. Boeser, M. Rossi, P. Cotter played 6:46 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Vancouver’s usual lines.
